editorial.blurb: This hidden-gem Ethiopian spot near the airport delivers authentic, freshly-shipped cuisine with genuine warmth and incredible value.
editorial.insiderTip: There's no menu—just 3 daily choices—so embrace the adventure and ask the owner what's being served that day; arrive early as options sell out quickly.
signatureDishes: beat stew with lentils on teff homemade bread

topDishes.note: perfectly seasoned greens and lentils with flawlessly cooked injera for scooping

topDishes.note: rich, flavorful home-meal cooking with organic ingredients
incredible flavor and generous portions for the price
